transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Ever since my daughter left for basic training, I just... I come home and the house feels dead. I can’t seem to hold it together. I’ve been crying in my truck before shifts, messing up steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, snapping at the younger guys. I quit going out on the water and stopped working on my sculpture too. I just don’t see the point lately.
About how long have you been experiencing these feelings?
It’s been about a month—since my daughter left. I’ve been struggling like this ever since.
Aside from feeling down, have you been having feelings of anxiety, nervousness, or constant worry?
I’m not sure I’d call it anxiety. I’ve mostly just been feeling low and kind of empty.
How has your sleep been over this past month?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep, honestly.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over this past month?
I haven’t really noticed any big changes in my appetite or weight. I’m not sure, though—I haven’t been paying close attention to that.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed whether my energy’s been different lately.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or that you would be better off dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really had a reason to think about that.
